definition: One of a pair of animals; a person you share something with.
examples: The male bird sings to find a mate.
Swans stay with one mate for life.
The lion was protecting his mate.

spanish.definition: Uno de los dos animales de una pareja; persona con la que compartes algo.

definition: The person who tells a story.
examples: The narrator of the book is a young boy.
The narrator has a very calm voice.
In this movie, the narrator never appears.

spanish.definition: Persona que cuenta una historia.

definition: A baby bird, especially a baby chicken.
examples: The chick came out of the egg.
The hen has six little chicks.
The kids love holding the yellow chicks at the farm.

spanish.definition: Ave bebé, sobre todo un pollo bebé.

definition: A title for a Christian minister.
examples: Reverend Brown will lead the service.
The reverend visited my grandmother.
We asked the reverend to marry us.

spanish.definition: Título de un ministro cristiano.

definition: To make two things work at the same time or have the same information.
examples: I need to sync my phone with my laptop.
The photos sync automatically.
The sound and the video aren't in sync.

spanish.definition: Hacer que dos cosas funcionen al mismo tiempo o tengan la misma información.

definition: An informal word for alcohol.
examples: There was a lot of booze at the party.
He stopped drinking booze last year.
We need to buy more booze for tonight.

spanish.definition: Palabra informal para el alcohol.

definition: The shooting of guns, or the sound it makes.
examples: We heard gunfire in the distance.
The gunfire stopped after ten minutes.
People ran when the gunfire started.

spanish.definition: Tiros de armas, o el sonido que hacen.

definition: Because of good luck.
examples: Luckily, nobody was hurt.
I forgot my wallet, but luckily I had some cash in my pocket.
Luckily, the store was still open.

spanish.definition: Gracias a la buena suerte.

definition: To become bigger, usually because of an injury.
examples: My ankle started to swell after I fell.
Her eyes were swollen from crying.
His finger is swelling up.

spanish.definition: Ponerse más grande, normalmente por una lesión.

definition: To push someone or something hard.
examples: Don't shove your sister!
He shoved the box under the bed.
She gave the door a hard shove.

spanish.definition: Empujar fuerte a alguien o algo.

definition: A polite word to show you are annoyed.
examples: Darn! I missed the bus.
Oh, darn, I left my keys at home.
Darn it, the printer isn't working again.

spanish.definition: Palabra educada para mostrar que estás molesto.

definition: Connected to fighting or the army.
examples: My son is learning martial arts.
Karate is a popular martial art.
The army declared martial law.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con la lucha o el ejército.

definition: The group of people who make laws in the US; a big formal meeting.
examples: Congress passed a new law.
She was elected to Congress in 2020.
Doctors from many countries came to the congress.

spanish.definition: Grupo de personas que hacen las leyes en Estados Unidos; reunión formal grande.

definition: A way of thinking about something.
examples: Try to see it from my perspective.
Living abroad gave me a new perspective.
She has a different perspective on money.

spanish.definition: Manera de pensar sobre algo.

definition: To make a small hole in something with a sharp object.
examples: She wants to pierce her ears.
The needle pierced his skin.
He's getting his ear pierced tomorrow.

spanish.definition: Hacer un hueco pequeño en algo con un objeto afilado.

definition: To ask for money by threatening to tell a secret.
examples: He tried to blackmail his boss.
She went to the police about the blackmail.
They blackmailed him with the photos.

spanish.definition: Pedir dinero amenazando con contar un secreto.

definition: A person who is easy to trick; a lollipop.
examples: He bought it for $500? What a sucker!
I'm a sucker for chocolate cake.
The doctor gave the kid a sucker.

spanish.definition: Persona fácil de engañar; dulce con palito.

definition: The person in charge of a prison.
examples: The warden walked through the prison.
He asked to see the warden.
The new warden made stricter rules.

spanish.definition: Persona a cargo de una prisión.

definition: The act of killing someone as a punishment; the act of doing a plan.
examples: The execution took place at dawn.
The idea was good, but the execution was bad.
The king ordered his execution.

spanish.definition: Acto de matar a alguien como castigo; acto de realizar un plan.

definition: Permission to leave prison early if you behave well.
examples: He got out on parole last month.
She was denied parole.
He broke his parole and went back to prison.

spanish.definition: Permiso para salir antes de la cárcel si te portas bien.

definition: A set of official rules for doing something.
examples: We have to follow the safety protocol.
The hospital has a strict protocol for this.
What's the protocol for a fire?

spanish.definition: Conjunto de reglas oficiales para hacer algo.

definition: To connect one thing with another in your mind; a person you work with.
examples: I associate that song with summer.
People often associate Paris with love.
He's a business associate of mine.

spanish.definition: Conectar una cosa con otra en la mente; persona con la que trabajas.

definition: The lawyers who try to prove in court that someone is guilty.
examples: The prosecution called its first witness.
The prosecution has strong evidence.
He's facing prosecution for fraud.

spanish.definition: Abogados que intentan probar en un juicio que alguien es culpable.

definition: A long gun used for hunting birds; the front passenger seat.
examples: The farmer keeps a shotgun in his truck.
He went hunting with his dad's shotgun.
I called shotgun, so I'm sitting in the front.

spanish.definition: Arma larga para cazar aves; asiento delantero del pasajero.

definition: Something very shameful; to bring shame to someone.
examples: This dirty hospital is a disgrace.
He left the company in disgrace.
You've disgraced your family.

spanish.definition: Algo muy vergonzoso; traer vergüenza a alguien.

definition: The state of being ill.
examples: She missed work because of sickness.
He gets motion sickness in cars.
The sickness spread through the town.

spanish.definition: Estado de estar enfermo.

definition: A person who acts in a crazy or dangerous way.
examples: That lunatic almost hit my car!
He was driving like a lunatic.
Who is the lunatic playing drums at 3 a.m.?

spanish.definition: Persona que actúa de forma loca o peligrosa.

definition: A small purple flower; a purple color.
examples: She picked some violets in the garden.
The sky turned violet at sunset.
He gave her a small bunch of violets.

spanish.definition: Flor pequeña de color morado; color morado.

definition: The light that comes from the sun.
examples: The room gets a lot of sunlight.
Plants need sunlight to grow.
Keep this medicine out of direct sunlight.

spanish.definition: Luz que viene del sol.

definition: The feeling of needing to drink something.
examples: This cold water will satisfy your thirst.
He was dying of thirst after the race.
Salty food gives me a terrible thirst.

spanish.definition: Sensación de necesitar beber algo.

definition: A style of printed letters.
examples: Please use a bigger font.
I don't like this font.
You can change the font in the settings.

spanish.definition: Estilo de letras impresas.

definition: The act of breaking a rule or a promise; to break a rule or a wall.
examples: That's a breach of our contract.
There was a security breach at the bank.
The water breached the wall.

spanish.definition: Acto de romper una regla o una promesa; romper una regla o un muro.

definition: A mix of two or more things; a group of buildings with a fence around them.
examples: Salt is a chemical compound.
The family lives in a large compound.
Guards protect the compound day and night.

spanish.definition: Mezcla de dos o más cosas; grupo de edificios con una cerca alrededor.

definition: Connected to a tribe.
examples: They still follow their tribal traditions.
He met with the tribal leaders.
The museum has tribal art from Africa.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con una tribu.

definition: A place where dead bodies are kept before a funeral.
examples: The body was taken to the morgue.
She works at the city morgue.
The police asked him to come to the morgue.

spanish.definition: Lugar donde se guardan los cadáveres antes del funeral.

definition: The part of a car that moves power to the wheels; the act of sending something.
examples: My car needs a new transmission.
The radio transmission was very clear.
Washing your hands stops the transmission of germs.

spanish.definition: Parte del carro que lleva la fuerza a las ruedas; acto de enviar algo.

definition: An old kind of short message sent by wire.
examples: She got a telegram from her brother.
People used to send telegrams for important news.
The telegram arrived at noon.

spanish.definition: Tipo antiguo de mensaje corto enviado por cable.

definition: A material that explodes, used to break rocks.
examples: They used dynamite to open the mine.
The workers blew up the old bridge with dynamite.
Dynamite is very dangerous.

spanish.definition: Material que explota, usado para romper rocas.

definition: The feeling of being sad.
examples: I could see the sadness in her eyes.
There was great sadness after his death.
She felt a deep sadness that day.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento de estar triste.

definition: A long time of asking someone hard questions, often by the police.
examples: The police took him in for interrogation.
The interrogation lasted six hours.
She stayed quiet during the interrogation.

spanish.definition: Tiempo largo de hacer preguntas difíciles, a menudo por la policía.

definition: A person who acts in a wild or dangerous way.
examples: He drives like a maniac.
Some maniac ran through the red light.
She's a maniac about cleaning.

spanish.definition: Persona que actúa de forma salvaje o peligrosa.

definition: An informal word for to prepare; preparation.
examples: I need to prep dinner before my guests arrive.
He's prepping for his test.
Meal prep saves me a lot of time.

spanish.definition: Palabra informal para preparar; preparación.

definition: An official who finds out why a person died.
examples: The coroner examined the body.
We're waiting for the coroner's report.
The coroner said it was an accident.

spanish.definition: Funcionario que averigua por qué murió una persona.

definition: A long trip for a special purpose.
examples: They went on an expedition to the South Pole.
She led an expedition up the mountain.
The expedition lasted three months.

spanish.definition: Viaje largo con un propósito especial.

definition: Connected to feelings of love or memories.
examples: This ring has sentimental value.
He gets sentimental at Christmas.
It's a sentimental movie about old friends.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con sentimientos de amor o recuerdos.

definition: An emotional request; the answer of guilty or not guilty in court.
examples: She made a plea for help.
He entered a plea of not guilty.
Nobody listened to their plea.

spanish.definition: Pedido emocional; respuesta de culpable o no culpable en un juicio.

definition: A peaceful situation; musical notes that sound good together.
examples: The neighbors live in harmony.
They sing in perfect harmony.
She wants harmony in her family.

spanish.definition: Situación de paz; notas musicales que suenan bien juntas.

definition: Not right for the situation.
examples: That joke was inappropriate.
Shorts are inappropriate for a funeral.
He said something inappropriate at work.

spanish.definition: Que no es correcto para la situación.

definition: A person who makes bowls and plates from clay.
examples: The potter made a beautiful bowl.
She works as a potter in a small town.
We watched the potter shape the clay.

spanish.definition: Persona que hace tazones y platos de arcilla.

definition: An area of soft, wet land.
examples: Many birds live in the marsh.
We walked along the edge of the marsh.
The marsh is full of tall grass.

spanish.definition: Área de tierra blanda y mojada.

definition: A system of tracks and trains.
examples: The old railway crosses the river.
They built a railway across the country.
He worked on the railway for thirty years.

spanish.definition: Sistema de vías y trenes.

definition: A strong car made for rough roads.
examples: We drove a jeep through the mountains.
The soldiers arrived in a jeep.
My uncle has an old green jeep.

spanish.definition: Carro fuerte hecho para caminos difíciles.

definition: A dishonest person; acting alone and against the rules.
examples: He's a charming old rogue.
A rogue police officer sold the guns.
The company fired the rogue employee.

spanish.definition: Persona deshonesta; que actúa solo y contra las reglas.

definition: For this reason.
examples: The bus was late, hence the delay.
He's from Texas, hence the hat.
It's made by hand, hence the high price.

spanish.definition: Por esta razón.

definition: A small insect that drinks blood; the sound a clock makes.
examples: The dog has a tick on its ear.
I could hear the clock ticking.
Check your legs for ticks after a hike.

spanish.definition: Insecto pequeño que chupa sangre; sonido que hace un reloj.

definition: A part of a city with its own police station.
examples: He works at the 12th precinct.
They took him to the precinct for questions.
Crime is down in this precinct.

spanish.definition: Parte de una ciudad con su propia estación de policía.

definition: To kill someone as a punishment; to carry out a plan.
examples: The team executed the plan perfectly.
The king executed his enemies.
The program will execute when you click the button.

spanish.definition: Matar a alguien como castigo; llevar a cabo un plan.

definition: To pull or carry something heavy.
examples: We hauled the boat out of the water.
This truck can haul a lot of wood.
It's a long haul from here to Denver.

spanish.definition: Jalar o cargar algo pesado.

definition: A metal bar that locks a door; to run away fast.
examples: He slid the bolt across the door.
The horse bolted when it heard the noise.
This bolt holds the wheel in place.

spanish.definition: Barra de metal que cierra una puerta; irse corriendo rápido.

definition: Able to pull metal toward it.
examples: This board is magnetic.
The earth has a magnetic field.
Hang your notes on the magnetic strip.

spanish.definition: Que puede atraer el metal hacia sí.

definition: The most important part of something; a strong liquid from a plant.
examples: Time is of the essence.
The essence of his idea is simple.
Add a few drops of vanilla essence.

spanish.definition: Parte más importante de algo; líquido fuerte de una planta.

definition: To try hard to make someone do something; a strong wish.
examples: I urge you to see a doctor.
He felt a sudden urge to run.
She urged him to stay.

spanish.definition: Tratar de que alguien haga algo con mucha fuerza; deseo fuerte.

definition: Pressure or worry; to hurt a muscle by using it too much.
examples: The job put a strain on our marriage.
I strained my back at the gym.
You'll strain your eyes in this light.

spanish.definition: Presión o preocupación; lastimar un músculo por usarlo demasiado.

definition: A feeling of caring about people who suffer.
examples: The nurse treated him with compassion.
She has so much compassion for animals.
We should show compassion to people in need.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento de preocuparse por la gente que sufre.

definition: A careful look at something; a formal test.
examples: The doctor did a full examination.
The final examination is in June.
A closer examination showed a small crack.

spanish.definition: Mirada cuidadosa a algo; prueba formal.

definition: To take part in an activity.
examples: Everyone can participate in the game.
She participates in class every day.
I didn't participate in the meeting.

spanish.definition: Tomar parte en una actividad.

definition: Added to what you already have.
examples: There's an additional charge for bags.
Do you need any additional information?
We hired two additional workers.

spanish.definition: Que se suma a lo que ya tienes.

definition: Something you think about all the time.
examples: Soccer is his obsession.
Her obsession with her weight is not healthy.
It started as a hobby and became an obsession.

spanish.definition: Algo en lo que piensas todo el tiempo.

definition: A long, narrow top of a mountain or hill.
examples: We hiked along the ridge.
The sun rose over the ridge.
There's a small cabin on the ridge.

spanish.definition: Parte alta, larga y estrecha de una montaña o colina.

definition: What you plan to do; very focused on something.
examples: He had no intent to hurt anyone.
She was intent on winning.
They arrested him for entering with intent to steal.

spanish.definition: Lo que planeas hacer; muy concentrado en algo.

definition: A tool with a sharp blade for cutting hair from the skin.
examples: I need a new razor.
He cut himself with the razor.
She keeps a razor in the shower.

spanish.definition: Herramienta con una hoja afilada para cortar el pelo de la piel.

definition: A deep valley with very steep sides.
examples: We visited the Grand Canyon.
A river runs through the canyon.
The view of the canyon was amazing.

spanish.definition: Valle profundo con lados muy empinados.

definition: Relaxed and not formal.
examples: You can wear casual clothes to the office on Friday.
We had a casual dinner at home.
He has a very casual style.

spanish.definition: Relajado y no formal.

definition: A frame for holding or hanging things.
examples: Put your coat on the rack.
The wine rack is in the kitchen.
She took a shirt from the rack.

spanish.definition: Estructura para sostener o colgar cosas.

definition: To change something a little; to get used to something new.
examples: You can adjust the seat.
It took me months to adjust to the cold weather.
He adjusted his tie in the mirror.

spanish.definition: Cambiar algo un poco; acostumbrarse a algo nuevo.

definition: A tall tree with thin, sharp leaves that stays green all year.
examples: The house is surrounded by pine trees.
The whole cabin smells like pine.
The table is made of pine.

spanish.definition: Árbol alto con hojas finas y puntiagudas que está verde todo el año.

definition: A gray bird that is common in cities.
examples: There are pigeons all over the park.
A pigeon landed on my window.
The old man feeds the pigeons every day.

spanish.definition: Ave gris muy común en las ciudades.

definition: The management of money; to give money for something.
examples: She works in finance.
My dad helped finance my car.
We need to look at our finances.

spanish.definition: Manejo del dinero; dar dinero para algo.

definition: Good, honest, and accepted by people.
examples: He comes from a respectable family.
She wanted a respectable job.
Put on a respectable shirt for dinner.

spanish.definition: Bueno, honesto y aceptado por la gente.

definition: A showing of how something works; a public protest.
examples: He gave us a demonstration of the new phone.
Thousands joined the demonstration.
The cooking demonstration starts at noon.

spanish.definition: Muestra de cómo funciona algo; protesta pública.

definition: A trick you play on someone for fun.
examples: The kids played a prank on their teacher.
It was just a prank.
He loves making prank calls.

spanish.definition: Truco que le haces a alguien por diversión.

definition: A small wooden music instrument with four strings.
examples: She plays the violin in an orchestra.
He has been taking violin lessons.
I can hear someone practicing the violin.

spanish.definition: Instrumento musical pequeño de madera con cuatro cuerdas.

definition: To move a spoon around in a liquid.
examples: Stir the soup so it doesn't burn.
She stirred sugar into her coffee.
Keep stirring until the sauce is thick.

spanish.definition: Mover una cuchara dentro de un líquido.

definition: A large sea fish that people eat.
examples: I had a tuna sandwich for lunch.
We opened a can of tuna.
Tuna is a good source of protein.

spanish.definition: Pez grande de mar que la gente come.

definition: To push the end of something into a place to keep it neat.
examples: Tuck your shirt into your pants.
She tucked her hair behind her ear.
I tucked the kids into bed.

spanish.definition: Empujar el extremo de algo en un lugar para que quede ordenado.

definition: A careful check of something.
examples: The car has to pass an inspection.
The restaurant failed its health inspection.
We had a home inspection before we bought it.

spanish.definition: Revisión cuidadosa de algo.

definition: A special table in a church.
examples: The couple stood at the altar.
She left him at the altar.
There were flowers on the altar.

spanish.definition: Mesa especial en una iglesia.

definition: A strong belief; a court decision that someone is guilty.
examples: She spoke with conviction.
He has one conviction for theft.
It's my conviction that everyone deserves a chance.

spanish.definition: Creencia fuerte; decisión de un juez de que alguien es culpable.

definition: A sweet food made from fruit that you put on bread.
examples: I'd like a peanut butter and jelly sandwich.
She spread grape jelly on her toast.
This jelly is made with fresh strawberries.

spanish.definition: Comida dulce hecha de fruta que se pone en el pan.

definition: A strong feeling of excitement; to make someone very excited.
examples: Riding a roller coaster is such a thrill.
The news thrilled the whole family.
He does it for the thrill.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento fuerte de entusiasmo; poner a alguien muy emocionado.

definition: A comfortable room where people can sit and relax.
examples: We waited in the airport lounge.
The teachers eat lunch in the lounge.
The hotel has a nice lounge with a piano.

spanish.definition: Cuarto cómodo donde la gente se sienta y descansa.

definition: A measurement of length, width, or height; a part of a situation.
examples: What are the dimensions of the room?
The movie is in three dimensions.
This adds a new dimension to the problem.

spanish.definition: Medida de largo, ancho o alto; parte de una situación.

definition: To be unable to breathe because something is in your throat.
examples: Be careful, the baby could choke on that.
He choked on a piece of meat.
The smoke was choking us.

spanish.definition: No poder respirar porque algo está en la garganta.

definition: A person whose job is to protect someone.
examples: The singer travels with two bodyguards.
His bodyguard stood next to the door.
She hired a bodyguard after the threats.

spanish.definition: Persona cuyo trabajo es proteger a alguien.

definition: Corn that is heated until it opens, eaten as a snack.
examples: Let's get some popcorn for the movie.
I love the smell of popcorn.
She made popcorn in the microwave.

spanish.definition: Maíz que se calienta hasta que se abre y se come como pasabocas.

definition: A movie or TV show about real events.
examples: We watched a documentary about sharks.
She made a documentary about her town.
This documentary won an award.

spanish.definition: Película o programa de TV sobre hechos reales.

definition: A person who gives money, blood, or a body part to help others.
examples: He's a regular blood donor.
She needs a kidney donor.
A donor gave the school $1 million.

spanish.definition: Persona que da dinero, sangre o un órgano para ayudar a otros.

definition: A loan from a bank to buy a house.
examples: We pay our mortgage every month.
They got a thirty-year mortgage.
The mortgage on this house is very high.

spanish.definition: Préstamo de un banco para comprar una casa.

definition: Very quickly.
examples: The city is growing rapidly.
Prices are rapidly going up.
The fire spread rapidly.

spanish.definition: Muy rápido.

definition: To talk about someone or something; to send someone to another person for help.
examples: Who are you referring to?
My doctor referred me to a specialist.
He didn't refer to the accident in his speech.

spanish.definition: Hablar de alguien o algo; enviar a alguien con otra persona para recibir ayuda.
